name: 文体计量分析
description: 分析 写作风格 特征 以检测 AI生成的 text through stylistic fingerprinting.
useCase: Identifying AI生成的 text 通过分析 写作风格 characteristics unique to human authors
mechanism: 提取 文体计量 特征 including sentence structure 模式, 标点符号 usage, paragraph organization, rhetorical devices, and 话语标记. Human writing exhibits consistent personal style signatures, while AI text shows characteristic 模式 of the generating model — often more formal, structured, and lacking personal quirks.
source: Uchendu et al. (2020) - Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation, EMNLP
algorithm: Stylometric Feature Extraction + Statistical Pattern Classification + Discourse Analysis
parameters: Features: 50+ stylistic markers, Min length: 200 words, Analysis: n-gram 分布, function 词频, 可读性 indices
strengths:
• Captures deep 写作风格 模式
• Effective on longer documents
• Can distinguish 之间 different AI models
• Robust against simple paraphrasing
limitations:
• Requires sufficient text length for reliable 分析
• Multi-author texts are challenging
• Professional editing can mask style signals
• Style varies by genre and context

references.title: Uchendu, A. et al. (2020). Authorship Attribution for Neural Text Generation. EMNLP.
Neal, T. et al. (2018). Surveying Stylometry Techniques and Applications. ACM Computing Surveys.
Kumarage, T. et al. (2023). Stylometric Detection of AI-Generated Text in Twitter Timelines. arXiv.
